rubric.role_summary: Senior manufacturing engineering role introducing capital tooling and automated assembly equipment for production. Own equipment projects from RFQ and vendor selection through acceptance testing, ramp, and handoff to production.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior manufacturing engineering role introducing capital tooling and automated assembly equipment for production. Own equipment projects from RFQ and vendor selection through acceptance testing, ramp, and handoff to production.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years in manufacturing engineering in a mass production environment.
- Experience taking products from low-rate prototype builds to high-volume production.
- Direct experience with robotic or automated assembly systems, either as the product being built or as the production method.
- Working proficiency with SolidWorks, CATIA, or equivalent 3D CAD.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.
- Experience working within a formal quality management system such as AS9100, ISO 9001, or IATF 16949, including participation in PFMEAs, control plans, and PPAP or FAI submissions.
- 5+ years in manufacturing engineering, with a track record of taking production equipment from RFQ through FAT, SAT, and SOP in a mass production environment.
- Experience managing external line builders and tooling suppliers against cost, schedule, and performance.
- Working proficiency with SolidWorks, CATIA, or equivalent 3D CAD sufficient to evaluate vendor designs and provide DFM and DFA input in cross-functional product development.
- Experience defining and hitting OEE, cycle time, and yield targets.
- Experience building business cases and ROI analyses to justify capital equipment decisions to senior leadership.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
